description:
THE restore drill - the key Layer-4 value. Restore the latest backup into a
    SCRATCH db (`odoo_restore_check`), confirm it opens (table count > 0), then DROP
    the scratch db. Touches ONLY the scratch db, so it is safe even post-go-live;
    still needs dry_run+confirm. Returns whether the restore actually worked.

    OFF-SITE: pass `s3_bucket=...` to ALSO check the copy that is NOT on this server - do the
    objects exist, does the newest object's size match the local dump of the same name, and how
    old is it (`max_age_hours`, default 36). That answer comes back as `offsite_status`
    (ok | stale | size_mismatch | missing | unknown) and `offsite_verified`. A local restore
    drill says nothing about the copy that survives losing the box, and vice versa - so the two
    verdicts are reported separately and neither is allowed to stand in for the other.
name: backup_verify
